scoring_justification: Checker recomputes W from the analytic formulas (3.2, 3.3, 3.5) and the material constants, comparing each CSV row with absolute tolerance 1e-6.

outputs.description: Recomputed isothermal heat exchange values for the Mooney-Rivlin-Besseling body under three deformation types. The checker will re-evaluate the same analytic formulas using the same material constants and parameter values, then compare each W value against the agent's submission with absolute tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The linear-elastic body (Section 2a) is omitted per taskability scope. The formulas for the Mooney-Rivlin-Besseling body are those derived in the paper: for pure volume change W = -c_E T_0 log(1 + c1(λ^{-6γ} - 1)); for simple shear W = -c_E T_0 log(1 + (c3/3) p^2); for isochoric shape change without shear W = -c_E T_0 log(1 + (c3/3)[(½+β2)(λ²+2/λ) + (½-β2)(2λ+1/λ²) - 3]). Only the constants and parameter sets stated in the step action are required.

steps.description: Row-by-row recompute of isothermal heat exchange W against the analytic formulas.
